headline: As of 2026-10-03: 1,160,958 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 29 of 50 states, D+33.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,160,958 early/mail ballots cast so far across 29 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+33.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (348,693), New Jersey (154,812), Florida (134,147).
